whyThisReaderIsIndependent: FIX-B built none of these five families and repaired none of them. Its own repair queue (FIX02/04/06/08) was re-dispatched to PF-A and is not reclaimed here. laneSummary: All five Washington vacation families verify independently on the nonvisual obligations: every rendered artifact rehashes to its declared digest, the field arithmetic closes exactly, every withheld blank carries a disposition inside the closed vocabulary, no protected field takes ink, and the declared component set is exactly what was rendered. The central raster receipt chain was additionally checked against the Actions API here, which the Captain session could not reach. Two limits remain open and are recorded rather than papered over: the raster PNG receipts are still unread by anyone, and source byte exactness still needs a corpus-bound reader.
